outcome.negative_finding_limit: This pass establishes insufficient verified evidence, not that these languages cannot express the messages or that no relevant source exists.

sources_attempted.access: Read introduction, methodology, transcription notes and references. Dynamic dictionary entry UI returned no entry text in web extraction. Public JS was inspected only to establish UI behavior; no deobfuscation or bulk extraction was attempted.

sources_attempted.authority: National Ainu Museum, Ainu Language Archive
sources_attempted.supports: SOV ordering; preposed somo negation; easkay/eaykap ability pair; poro as be/become big; no inflectional past tense; importance of transitivity.
sources_attempted.limit: No authenticated pororu, kampiso, sinnare or complete technical-clause attestation obtained.

sources_attempted.access: Read archive description and dictionary provenance, including Kayano and Tamura (1996). Targeted web-tool dictionary requests below failed. Did not scrape or download the archive in bulk.

sources_attempted.authority: NINJAL Glossed Audio Corpus of Ainu Folklore
sources_attempted.access: Read introductory grammar and person-marking table.
sources_attempted.supports: a= is fourth-person transitive subject marking with several functions; not a universal passive particle. Ordinary objects and adjuncts have different marking.
sources_attempted.limit: Useful general grammar; no declaration/substitution/resizing sentence verified.

sources_attempted.authority: Hokkaido Ainu Culture Research Center bulletin 15 (2009), article on historical facts and trade in Ainu oral literature
sources_attempted.supports: Distinguishes itasare, tasare and utasare in exchange/trade contexts.
sources_attempted.limit: Does not establish a software-size substitution use or the needed argument construction. Do not directly swap this lexeme into a technical clause.

sources_attempted.authority: Independent modern compilation, not an institutional dictionary or native-review certificate
sources_attempted.access: Read the public introductory caveat and directly inspected the public data file https://ss1.xrea.com/toracatman.s324.xrea.com/ainu/js/ainu.js. Confirmed pororu, size, poro + ru, labelled 造語, and N1 eywanke, use N1.
sources_attempted.supports: A named existing lexical compilation documents pororu. It is not an term newly coined in this pass. Coinage status alone is not a reason to reject it; this is legitimate terminology evidence, but community acceptance and suitability to software dimensions are not established.
sources_attempted.limit: No source entry for the exact sinnare form was found in this one data file; absence is not proof that it is invalid. Full constructions remain to be evaluated on grammar and meaning, not on presence of a matching UI sentence.

next_review_questions: Can a qualified speaker/editor validate a paraphrase meaning “The SVG contains no usable specification of its original width and height” without implying that the SVG itself is missing?
How should “we did not use dimensions obtained from the canvas instead” be expressed naturally?
How should “the original width/height exceeds the Android bitmap limit” be stated without confusing it with RAM or file bytes?
Can “we did not change the image dimensions” be verified with completed-event scope and no restriction to automatic resizing or shrinking?
method_note: Normal compositional translation is allowed. A full UI sentence need not occur in a dictionary. Withholding here reflects unresolved lexical choices, predicate argument structure and scope in the actual proposed constructions, not a requirement for exact-match UI attestation.

partial_phrases.remaining: Hoski as original/intrinsic in this noun phrase and the technical scope of pororu still require review. This phrase is not independently accepted.

partial_phrases.origin: Existing catalogue; NINJAL mutu original + attested nu noun modifier, with catalogue loanword サイズ.
partial_phrases.remaining: Orthography/pronunciation and intrinsic-image sense should be checked in the final sentence.

partial_phrases.origin: The catalogue supplies 自動っし サイズけーゆしや さびらんたん。 NINJAL supports kee=juN change and ordinary negative-past saNtaN.
partial_phrases.remaining: Remove automatic-only scope; do not claim that this mechanical deletion independently validates the polite nominalized construction. Confirm either a natural active negative-past change-size clause or this nominalized polite form.

additional_support.ryu_dimension_limit: Miyara 2021 text example 4898 supports the underlying permitted/impermissible size distinction; no exact UI attestation is required.
additional_support.ain_lexical_origin: pororu is an externally documented coinage, not an invented translation term in this pass.
